meta.name: airflow-dag-patterns
meta.description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.

copy.tagline: 构建生产级的数据管道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是数据工程师,用 Airflow 编排任务,想写出更规范的 DAG。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage data pipelines and want reliable, maintainable DAGs.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Airflow 的生产模式写 DAG：设计任务依赖结构、编写 operator 与 sensor、配置重试与超时，并给出本地测试和部署设置，产出可直接运行的 DAG 代码。
howto.when: 当你创建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批处理任务时触发；设计 DAG 结构、写自定义 operator/sensor、调试失败的 DAG 运行等场景也会用到。

say.text: 帮我写一个每天 6 点运行的 Airflow ETL DAG
say.note: 会给出含重试、超时配置的完整 DAG 代码

say.text: 把这个 DAG 的 sensor 改成 reschedule 模式
say.note: 会换成释放 worker 的 sensor 写法

say.text: 我的 DAG 运行失败了，帮我加指数退避重试
say.note: 会补上重试与退避相关配置

howto.what_en: Installs Airflow DAG patterns: Claude designs task dependencies, writes operators and sensors, sets retries and timeouts, and gives local testing and deployment setup, producing runnable DAG code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, or schedule batch jobs; also for DAG structure design, custom operators/sensors, local testing, or debugging failed runs.

say_en.text: Write me an Airflow ETL DAG that runs daily at 6 AM
say_en.note: Returns full DAG code with retries and timeouts

say_en.text: Switch this DAG's sensor to reschedule mode
say_en.note: Uses the sensor style that frees up workers

say_en.text: My DAG run failed; add exponential backoff retries
